reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I’m very pleased with the service! This was my puppy’s very first grooming appointment, and they did an amazing job. When I picked her up, she looked like a completely different dog! She looked absolutely beautiful, smelled amazing, and was so clean and fresh. I couldn’t be happier with the results. Thank you for taking such great care of my puppy. I highly recommend this place and will definitely be coming back!
They did a great job with my Yorkie. Was able to book appointment same day & he was ready for pick up within 2 hours. Highly recommend
Very caring and friendly i will be happy to refer family and friends

Loved Barking Pet Spa. My maltipoo came back smelling wonderful, mattes gone, and looking like a cute teddy bear. The price was just right for better quality grooming than I've gotten from chain places. Definitely recommend.

Absolutely loved the service! Everyone was so kind, professional, and caring. My little one looks absolutely adorable and was so happy afterward. I’m very satisfied with the experience and will definitely be coming back! Highly recommend! 🐶❤️

Edit: they always do a good job with his haircut! Updated photos with the before and after with the red bow.

My fur baby got his first grooming here (blue bow).
He looks so dapper after and they even gave him a cute bow. Reasonable pricing! I will come back again!
Wonderful spot my dog looks so cute thank you so much
Excellent
Took my dog to get his nails trimmed, They Did An Excellent Job, Great Prices & Walk-In's Welcome
Smooth and easy great service
The did absolutely amazing I love how they styled my baby
Have been coming since I got my girl. Super nice service and reasonable price. Highly recommended!
They did a great job! Super fast for a full grooming & great pricing!

The service was horrible. We went to get my dog's nails trimmed, and they didn't have a muzzle to put on her, but yet they still wanted to charge us for the full service her ears wasn’t clean bad place "0" for this place.

Love the staff! Always takes care of both cats and dogs properly. Gives a proper exam of the pet to let you know anything you need to do or add to the routine/care, text messages when finished, and reward point system! 10/10
Great experience, very friendly, got excatly what I wanted for my dogs and the prices are great. I will be back

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Highly recommend Barking Pet Spa! They did an amazing job grooming my little Shih Tzu. He went in looking a little rough and came out looking great! The staff was professional, friendly, and the shop was clean. My dog was comfortable from the moment I dropped her off, and I’ll definitely be coming back!

This place is a such a blessing!!
They treated me & my little Furrbaby like family.  So kind thoughtful & professional.  They asked me everything concerning how I would like her groomed . I really  loved their attention to detail & how considerate they treated me & my most Important Furrbaby.
She came out looking  so Gorgeous!!

10/10! They seriously did such a good job. His face is perfectly rounded, the body is nice and even, and he still looks fluffy without being too long. He looks so clean and cute, and you can tell they took their time. Definitely one of my favorite haircuts he’s had. I’d 100% go back! 🐶💕
very friendly !

Great location!
The staff was very kind and they did a great job on my dog. Thank you team ❤️

They always do a great job with my dog! I’ve tried to groom him myself in the past but he moves a lot and is very difficult to work with. So I decided to start bringing him here to be groomed. After every groom he is always very alert and happy so I know for sure I can trust them to take care of him :)
Very satisfied , great experience.

Owner was easy to communicate grooming needs. Just love my furbabies fresh bath & cuts. The cute bows were adorable

Brought  my fur grand baby two weeks later and he’s happy, has a beautiful fresh cut

Just love how much they care and the time they take
Got hairstyle pictures to choose from, great recommendations from the staff as well. All your dog’s essential care are included! Surprisingly cute every time picking my fur baby up:)
Excellent service! I absolutely love my pups cute. I am a customer now for sure.
Very patient with my baby

I love this shop. They were VERY patient with me. I came in with a Groupon and the app was messing up, the owner even came and tried to help me figure it out. It was frustrating for me to say the least. But seeing how calm and patient they were, made me a less anxious about the whole situation. Well it all worked out in the end. Now they did the best job on my Doodle. She didn’t even act crazy with them lol. Especially when cutting her face. She gives us the blues at home. I’ll definitely be coming back

I brought my dog in for grooming and also bought a few items while waiting. The grooming took a bit longer than they initially said, which was slightly inconvenient since I had other plans, but they kept me updated. When I picked him up, he looked clean and well taken care of, though there was a small uneven trim near the paw area that I noticed later. The staff listened when I mentioned it and offered to adjust it next time. The shop itself has a friendly atmosphere, and you can tell they handle pets regularly.
The best pet salon ever.
Excellent work y attention
Most reliable and affordable groomers ever!

Hi Trung Pham
We’re sorry to hear you weren’t satisfied with your experience. When your dog arrived, their coat was severely matted over the entire body, which required extra time and care to groom safely and comfortably.
Our staff explained the condition and the necessary price adjustment before starting, and we only proceeded with your approval. We always prioritize pets’ comfort and safety first.
We appreciate your feedback and are happy to discuss this further if you’d like to reach us directly
Very poor service and very poor customer service.
Amazing dog grooming in Chinatown, my dog was very matted and they took great care of her. Very efficient in and out in exactly 2 hours. She was so happy and looked amazing.
Super quick and easy experience. They got my dog in and out fast, but still did a really good job. Prices are very fair too, especially for how convenient it was. Definitely coming back.
Amazing service,fast and very caring

Online it said $85 for cat bath including nail trim. When I dropped my cat off the guy asked if I wanted hair trim and I specifically said NO just the bath and NAIL trim I booked. After 2 hrs and 30 min my cat was ready and total was $95 (should be transparent) about card payments. When I got home I noticed they CUT my cats chest hair 😭 he is a long hair cat and did not want his hair cut at all. You can. See where they cut hos chest hair where scissors cut. Will not return. So upset about it.
My Daughter's Cat her third time they did a great job.

This is The Spot you all. I've had my Golden Doodle for 5 years and I never could find a groomer to cut him the way I wanted. Well my son's boss referred me to Barking Pet Spa and I cried the first time Ms Nancy cut him. I'm so happy and want to tell everyone to come get your Wish On..Yes. You will be very pleased 😄
My puppy looks to cute and it didn't take all day
My dog is a epileptic dog, he did great with Nancy 🤗
My dog always looks so adorable. They never miss❤️
GREAT place! ☺️ Will be bringing my baby back here! She was very calm after her appointment which has been way better than previous places, and she looks fabulous after 🥹

This service here is not at all any good. the wait time is very long and I was very unsatisfied with how rude the staff was. They should assume that many other people can understand their language and disrespect is not how you retain customers..

This place is highly unprofessional. The owner was very rude and abrupt when I called and asked when my dog would be ready for pick up after waiting 5hrs.

Today upon picking up my dog, they were just getting to her and asked for another 20 mins. The cut looked very rushed and I questioned if they actually did a "full groom". When smelling my dogs breathe.. it was not brushed at all. They then proceeded to do a "special service" to up charge me 150 dollars!!

When I refused to pay for the "special service" done by "vets", after never being told this service was being done.. they proceeded to send a very lengthily text terminating service.

After such a horrible experience, they will not have to ever worry about me or my dog stepping foot in the putrid and unhygienic establishment ever again!!

Be sure to OVER COMMUNICATE if you decide to trust these folks with your precious  animal .. or you may end up just like me and my dog or worse..

Thank you for your feedback. We’re sorry to hear you were not satisfied with your experience. Our team works hard to provide safe, professional, and caring service for every pet. If you’re open to it, please contact us directly so we can better understand your concerns and work toward a resolution.
I love her style and cut she gave my two cavwpoo

After much searching, I finally found a pet shop run by Chinese people. I didn't have high hopes, but I was pleasantly surprised when I actually received the puppy. It seems only Chinese people can understand the needs of Chinese people. It has a round head and a round muzzle, and the hair on its penis was left for urination. The anus and four little paws were shaved very cleanly. I am very satisfied with this level of skill in the US, and I have already recommended it to my four Corgi friends.
Really good service
The haircut is perfect.

Went in to get my dog a trim everything was good until the pick up I was waiting a bit for them to finish up with my dog
the lady at the front desk was talking with another client (in their language) thought I wouldn’t understand and started talking bad abt my Appearance. After giving me my dog back had the nerve to say see you in 4 weeks.
Our parti yorkie Charlie looked excellent after his cut—just like a teddy bear. We love this place!

My baby always comes back happy and more beautiful
Thanks guys!
Best grooming experience ever! My dog looks like a little model after every visit. Highly recommend!
Great service and friendly staff!

Amazing boarding experience!

My cat was very well taken care of, and I received daily updates. The service was professional and gave me great peace of mind.
Amazing. Thank you for your help
Wonderful customer service and they did a great job on my chihuahua. Will definitely return!

Absolutely wonderful cat bath experience!

The owner here is incredibly professional and truly cares about the animals. They treated my cat with so much friendliness and patience, which means a lot because my cat can be a little shy at first. You can really feel that they love what they do.

Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a trustworthy and gentle groomer. I’ll definitely be coming back! 🐱💛
Great service. Nice place to take care of your pets
Being a customer since they were open. This is the only place that my dog would allow the groomers cut her nails.
They did a great job grooming my cat. Very patient, gentle, and professional. My cat looks so much better. Highly recommend!
I’ve been coming here for over a year and never once had a bad experience. They always remember my dog’s preferences too!

The grooming itself wasn’t an issue, but when it was time to pay, the staff member told me that the price displayed at their store is only for Zelle or Cashapp and it was a different price entirely if I was paying with my card. If that was communicated with me ahead of time, I would’ve gone somewhere else and I’m sure they know that.
My golden retriever always looks amazing after every grooming session here! The staff is super gentle and professional. You can tell they truly care about animals.

Our dog is extremely sensitive and it's impossible to groom her at home,
but whenever we take her here, she never seems stressed at all.
She always comes back looking so beautiful!
Thank you so much for grooming her so beautifully
and taking such good care of her!
Excellent service
Great services, my fur baby so cute and clean.
Nice service.. but still can be improved with quality of grooming... So fast no always so good
Excellent quality haircut and grooming for all three of my dogs. Used to take to Chinatown location, very convenient Katy location.

I had a very good experience because my dog ​​came in with a lot of knots, and she still looked beautiful. I feel she was treated well because she was very calm. Despite the knots all over her body, her face looked lovely. And their prices are fair.
Quick and friendly service

Nice Service!!!
I’m very satisfied with my dog’s grooming. The service was excellent, and I’ll definitely come back next time.
Love this place
Excellent
Nancy's customer service was great she was very friendly with my dog as well as my self... she was very informative and expressed her concerns which was very helpful.

We took our blind 12-year-old Shih Tzu who doesn’t like to leave the house to them for a full groom, and they did a beautiful job. The dog was fairly relaxed when we went to pick him up, too, which was nice. We highly recommend this company.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Just had my dog Shady fully groomed at Barking Pet Spa and I couldn’t be happier! The staff was gentle, professional, and clearly care about the pets they work with. Shady came back looking (and smelling) amazing — clean, trimmed, and happy. Highly recommend them if you want your pup treated right!
Nice hair cut and good service, my puppy was enjoy it
Very good service
Awesome job!
Took my small dog here a total mess and they took extremely good care of her. They you ladies 💗 …
Thank you for your 7 negative review in a row!
Took my kitten here for her first grooming—she came out looking even more adorable! The groomer was gentle and clearly loves animals.
This place is amazing! My cat usually hates being groomed, but the staff here handled her with such care. She came home clean. Highly recommend
My baby looked fabulous!  She enjoyed her visit and was relaxed and happy to see me.  That's important.  And she knew she looked cute!
Staff are super friendly and helpful! Great selection of pet food, toys, and grooming essentials. My dog loves visiting this place
She did such a great job with my giant cat. I will definitely be returning:) Just look at him, so comfortable and clean.

Chanel’s spa day was nothing short of couture! The groomers treated my prized shih tzu like royalty—her coat is now impossibly soft, her nails filed to perfection, and that signature pink bow is *chef’s kiss*. Five stars isn’t enough; this is the Chanel No. 5 of dog grooming!
Always the best service very reliable and friendly people can trust your dog to be safe in their hands ♥️♥️♥️♥️

This is probably the easiest review I’ve ever written because I honestly love how the grooming turned out. The price is super affordable, everyone there is really friendly, and they’re clearly professionals. They gave me great advice on what would work best for my dogs and even pointed out a possible skin issue I hadn’t noticed. You can tell they really care and take pride in their work. And the results? So good!
Great service and the girls are very nice. My baby looks amazing. It was fast and perfect job. Thank you!
Text for easy booking! And out of all the grooming places his haircut came out the most accurate to what I asked for.

Barking Pet Spa is the best when it comes to grooming, and the ladies there are so nice and welcoming. The prices are inexpensive, and the service is on point. My dog was so happy and playful. He loves this place. This will be my forever grooming Spa.

I'm new to Houston and needed grooming for my dog. With everything costing so much these days, the ladies at Barking Pet Spa was just so delightful and professional. The prices are very inexpensive and my dog was so happy. This is my forever grooming spa. Great work!!!!👍 …
Very professional! All pictures on the wall of furbabies were so cute! And my baby was just as cute!

I had an amazing experience the first time I walked in the door. The animals that were were extremely calm and relaxed. The staff is beyond incredible!! The service is top tier and extremely welcoming. The grooming and treatment was the best I’ve ever experienced. I’ll forward be a loyal customer 💯🩷 …
Excellent I recommend 👌 I have a dog cocker spaniel and they cut his hair very well 👍🏻 👌 😀. …
Great staff, I love taking my dog to the barking pet spa!
I had a great first experience. Highly recommend they are professional and friendly!

They cut my dogs hair OFF so short with a full(#1) blade that it took his skin off.  He is in pain.
I HAD TO TAKE HIM TO THE VET.  THEY EVEN ASKED FOR A TIP. NO SHAM.!!!
Love the experience my dog Bentley look so amazing very patient I will see them again thanks so much
As for grooming services, the owner is one of the few (if not only) groomer in Houston that can offer Asian-style cuts (think round, fluffy, small and Instagram-famous dogs).
Took my dog here for a full haircut and it was a pleasant experience for both me and the pup. The shop was clean and the staff were very friendly and professional. Highly recommend!

The place is somewhat hidden and small, but the service is definitely very good. From the receptionist to the person who grooms the dogs, they ask you even the smallest details about how you want your dog’s haircut, and I really liked that.

If you go on the weekend, it will take about 2 to 3 hours (due to high demand), but the location is so convenient that you can grab a meal or a drink nearby while you wait.

I’ll definitely come back with my puppy.
Nancy and her staff re great! Clean facility. Professional and friendly. Very reasonably priced.
Love it here! The owner of the shop cuts my pupper’s hair really well!
Nancy and Tina are very easy to work with. The store is clean. Highly recommended
Nancy is always very kind and gives the best asian fusion haircuts! The pricing is very reasonable for excellent services.
Absolutely fantastic service! The attention to detail was impressive, and my pet seemed so relaxed and happy afterward. They looked and felt amazing. Highly recommend !
Amazing price and incredible service
The grooming service is top-notch! My dog’s haircut is always stylish and professionally done.
What else can I say….,Nancy did a terrific job. Our baby boy looks so handsome! Thank you Nancy
dropped off my 7 months old yorkie for his first grooming service, ready in 1.5 hrs!  They even recommended what to feed my puppy to keep up with a healthy coat. Love their service.
They do detailed consultation before the service, which made us feel comfortable for our first visit! My pup came home very clean and fresh.
They did a fantastic job grooming my dog. The attention to detail is incredible, and my pup came out looking great!
Love the hair cut so much
My boy loves it there ; he hates party hats tho 😝 …
Great job!!! My fur baby looked beautiful !!
My german shepherd Luna had a great bath here! Very friendly experience would definitely come again!! I like the cats wandering around inside the shop.
Brought my pup in looking a bit scruffy, and he came out looking like a star! The groomer was so patient and gentle, and my dog seemed completely at ease. Couldn’t be happier with the result !
Very good dog very happy

My cat is a scaredy-cat with long fur, and I've always been nervous about taking him for a bath. His belly fur was so tangled up, I didn’t know what to do! Until I found this place. i wouldn’t trust my eye! my baby was so chill in Nancy’s hands—it was so wild! Since he’s nervous, they had to dry him nice and slow, then using one of those box dryers for finishing drying his face. The whole process took about four hours, and the staff was amazing the entire time. They shaved off the matted on his belly and gave me tips on how to prevent skin issues.  Highly recommend! Ill defiantly come back with my baby!

Barking Pet Spa in H Mart Center, Chinatown, is truly a gem for pet lovers. The moment I noticed the eye-catching pink sign, I knew I had stumbled upon something special. The owner, ManMan , is a fountain of knowledge and shows remarkable attention to detail and care for our furry friends.

While enjoying a meal in sterling Plaza in Chinatown. I couldn't resist exploring the facility. It's impeccably clean, emanating a pleasant aroma with an array of collectibles, pet vitamins, and washing stations. The playing area is delightful, and the owner's kitty is a charming addition – playing with her became an unexpected relaxation break.

Witnessing the spa treatments for the dogs was a joy. The staff's expertise and the serene atmosphere made the experience not only enjoyable for me but reassuring for the dogs. My pup, typically nervous, seemed at ease, and I knew I had found the perfect daycare for my furry companions.

I am confident that Barking Pet Spa will be my go-to place whenever I'm on a business trip or vacation. The peace of mind I have knowing my babies are well cared for is invaluable. I highly recommend this amazing pet spa  – a haven for pets and a relief for pet parents like myself. Looking forward to seeing if my fur babies love the vitamins too!
